pick.headline: El Salvador's election returns: Duarte leads, D'Aubuisson claims victory
pick.summary: On March 29, 1982, the day after El Salvador's Constituent Assembly election, early returns put President Duarte's Christian Democrats ahead, while Roberto D'Aubuisson of the right-wing ARENA party claimed victory and called for a coalition of the right.
pick.significance: Washington had backed the election as proof of a democratic path amid civil war. The right-wing parties together won a majority and made D'Aubuisson, linked to the death squads, president of the assembly, an outcome that complicated U.S. support for the government.
pick.fbis: The Latin America Daily Report of March 29, 1982, listed under El Salvador a long election run: early victory claims, D'Aubuisson urging a coalition, the PDC's early lead, returns, guerrilla attacks and turnout.
